newsitem.title: UK: All five Brent cargoes kept from chains-traders.
newsitem.headline: All five Brent cargoes kept from chains-traders.

text.p: All five of the Brent crude cargoes turning wet through the paper chains on Friday were kept, traders involved in the chains said.
They said British Petroleum kept two, loading February 22-24 and 23-25, and the remainder, loading February 22-24, 23-25 and 24-26, were kept by J Aron.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 GMT London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
